regions.today: Mostly dry today with a mix of cloud and hazy sunny spells, and with just a few showers possible. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees with a light, occasionally moderate westerly breeze.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees in a mostly light southwesterly or variable breeze with some mist and fog patches developing.
regions.tomorrow: Staying largely dry tomorrow with a mix of cloud and sunny spells and just isolated showers. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees in light to moderate southwesterly winds.
